customer.title: Customer Service Bot
customer.problem: Support teams are overwhelmed. 70% of queries are repetitive. Response times are hours, not minutes.
customer.solution: AI bot handles common queries instantly, escalates complex issues to humans with full context.

citizen.title: Citizen Portal
citizen.problem: Government services have long wait times. Citizens struggle to navigate complex processes.
citizen.solution: AI-powered portal guides citizens through applications, tracks status, and answers questions 24/7.

multichannel.title: Multi-Channel Support
multichannel.problem: Customers reach out via chat, email, SMS, social media. Context is lost between channels.
multichannel.solution: Unified AI platform maintains conversation history across all channels, providing seamless experience.

quality.title: Service Quality Assurance
quality.problem: Manual call review is slow. Quality issues are discovered too late. Training gaps are unclear.
quality.solution: AI analyzes 100% of interactions in real-time, identifies issues, and recommends training.
